detail.title: Observer-Measurement Perturbation and Falsification Foundations
detail.summary: We are prioritizing the resolution of inherited, overdue commitments regarding falsification frameworks in error detection. Following established governance, we are conducting focused research to obtain sufficient evidence to synthesize the overdue notebook for the error-detection domain. Concurrently, we continue the investigation of observer effects and informational entropy in active projects, ensuring that all findings are derived from verifiable sources while maintaining strict adherence to the defined research mission and treating opaque digests as non-semantic anchors.
